judgments.note: Docs call metadata.* an alternate location with no order; top-level first is the safest reading.
Docs give only examples. Re-run oracle 2.1.325: official-claude-plugins draws the impersonation error.
2.1.321 validation table lists npm…gh as validator errors; oracle 2.1.325: a marketplace named npm passes validation. Docs verdict kept, oracle wording for claude-plugin-test.
Docs name only which entry fields combine when plugin.json is present; others not applying is the safest reading.
Docs list dependencies as an entry field with no combining rule; append keeps the catalog's requirements.
Docs say only 'a relative path inside the marketplace'. Re-run oracle 2.1.325: pluginRoot "plugins" with source "p" passes validation.
Docs give no validation message. Re-run oracle 2.1.325: url source with owner/repo draws no validator error.
Docs give the command rules, not the message wording; evidence named.
cli-reference.md marketplace add table gives forms without precedence; reference marketplace-input.ts matches (~/ prefix).
Docs say 'characters' and 'bare lowercase hostname'. Re-run oracle 2.1.325: hosts entry Example.com draws 'must be a lowercase bare hostname (no scheme, port, or path)'.
Docs table lists the messages without precedence; oracle evidence named.
loading.md gives the order and table only; blank strings, folder-name limits and path hash form are silent.
Docs give no version rule for session-only plugins; oracle evidence named.
Docs state the skip list for name@marketplace only. Text of §16.17 item 3 aligned with the judgment (managed block for a bare name drops, does not refuse).
loading.md: 'a random delay of up to ten minutes', nothing on repetition.
org.md 'Seed containers and CI': a seed forces autoUpdate off; writable files for the toggle unstated.
host-marketplace.md says managed-only installs stay, not whether they are flagged; never uninstalling on a broken renames chain is the safest reading.
settings-reference.md gives two values and a managed floor; rest silent.
Docs say only the fields are strings. Re-run oracle 2.1.325: "a@b@c" and {version:"^1"} draw dependencies.<i>: Invalid input; an invalid range and an extra key pass.
Docs say 'at the same scope' only; depth and cycles silent.
Docs give <plugin-name>--v<version> only.
Docs say 'several installed plugins'; excluding the plugin's own stale range is the safest reading.
troubleshooting.md names the message, not the method or limit.
dependencies.md quotes the start and says it 'names the field to set'.
Docs cover disable refusal, silent on uninstall; oracle 2.1.322 evidence from the reference tests, not re-run (writes state).
troubleshooting.md quotes the opening only; oracle 2.1.325 evidence named.
